name: jellyfin-cc-sync
description: Keeps one Jellyfin user's watched state, favourites and jcc-* tags in line with a jClipCorn database, and writes watches made in Jellyfin back into jClipCorn's viewed history.
overview: Syncs watch state, favourites and tags with a jClipCorn database

versions.changelog:
Release 1.0.1.0: a brief replay of a watched item is no longer a watch

Jellyfin leaves Played set while an already watched item is replayed and
saves user data with PlaybackFinished on every stop, so the delayed
UserDataSaved fallback queued a pending update for any stop of such an
item, even after a few seconds.

The session tracker now keeps the furthest position reported per session,
and the fallback only fires when the item's most recently active session
reached the watched threshold. A finished watch drops every tracked
session of the item, so an earlier partial session never counts towards
a later stop. Pausing and finishing later, also in a new session after a
client restart, still counts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NDoExrFyrE9fbsjSNuV8A9

Requires jClipCorn user data v4: viewed history entries are written as {d,c} objects with a configurable comment (HistoryComment, default: from jellyfin-cc-sync). Repeated watch signals within the dedup window are recorded as duplicates and never written. Accepts jClipCorn main schema 38 and 39.
